events.title: LAMP @ Government House
events.description: His Honour The Honourable Mike Savage, Lieutenant Governor of Nova Scotia, and Ms. Darlene Savage invite you to join them in Halifax for an evening of music as part of the Evenings @ Government House series, a free public event series celebrating the history, heritage, and culture of Nova Scotia. Each year, the series welcomes speakers and performers from across the province to entertain and educate audiences.

events.title: "Fellow Creatures" Exhibition by Michael Peters
events.description: Join us on Thursday, October 29th at 7:00 PM for the Opening Reception and Artist Talk for “Fellow Creatures,” our upcoming Exhibition by Michael Peters. In the exhibition of mixed-media drawing and paintings on paper—Fellow Creatures—Michael reimagines whales, sharks, jellyfish, octopuses and other marine creatures not as simple depictions of nature, but as talismans forged from earth and sea. Part natural myth, part meditation, each creature is both the thing itself and the idea of that…

events.title: LAMP @ Lunenburg School of the Arts
events.description: Bring along your sketchbook, knitting, or any other project you've got on the go, and settle in alongside fellow makers and music lovers for an hour of shared creativity. As you draw, craft, or create, LAMP's visiting violist, Tilman Sandvoss , will provide the musical accompaniment, offering a unique and more personal way to experience live performance. All ages and levels of artistic experience are welcome.

events.title: Eden Chen, piano
events.description: Eden is currently preparing his upcoming album, Memory’s Atlas , to be recorded with PENTATONE . Memory’s Atlas pairs Ravel’s Le Tombeau de Couperin with his original arrangements of work by Ryuichi Sakamoto. The program reflects on the awe and ache of memory’s transformations, as we revisit the past only through the language and technology we have today.

events.title: “Acting for Animation” with Alex Rochon (voice of Caine on THE AMAZING DIGITAL CIRCUS)
events.description: What does it take to thrive as a voice actor? Hal-Con presenter Alex Rochon will tell us in this intimate conversation. You’ll learn all about Alex’s compelling journey through the industry, from recording voiceovers in his closet to attending red carpet events and international conventions. Attendees will also get tips on how to use their own voices to capture the essence of an animated character. Whether you’re a fan of DIGITAL CIRCUS, are interested in voice acting, or just love a good conversation with fascinating people, this one is not to be missed!

events.title: Bach, Bach, Bach & Bach
events.description: Step into the extraordinary musical dynasty of the Bach family, where genius spanned generations and styles evolved before your ears. From the radiant brilliance of Johann Sebastian Bach to the bold, expressive voices of Johann Bernhard Bach and Wilhelm Friedemann Bach, this concert traces the shift from high Baroque splendour to the dawn of the Classical era. With lively sinfonias, virtuosic concertos, and exuberant orchestral suites, it’s a vibrant celebration of family legacy and the Bach name. events.title: Tilman Sandvoss, viola
events.description: His residency program brings together works spanning from the Baroque to the twentieth century, including music by Johann Sebastian Bach, Rebecca Clarke, Georges Enescu, Johannes Brahms, Paul Hindemith, Vincent Ho, and Jessie Montgomery. Together, these works represent the breadth of the viola’s repertoire, highlighting the instrument’s expressive range as both a solo and chamber music voice. The inclusion of Tilman’s own arrangements reflects his ongoing interest in expanding the repertoire available to violists and presenting familiar works from new perspectives.

events.title: Tunes on Tuesday: Trio Timia
events.description: Montréal-based group Trio Timia present an engaging lecture recital exploring the artistry of the piano trio. Featuring pianist Itamar Prag , violinist June Lee , and cellist François Lamontagne , this prize-winning trio will offer insight into their approach to chamber music and the works they perform.
